description: Election  Commission - Declare that Wathupiti  Kandalage Shantha Kumara  as a member of the Colombo Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Colombo Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) as it pertains to electoral processes and declarations at the local government level.
